notify.footer: You are receiving this because you are a member of {{.Org}} on OpsHub.
notify.pipeline.failed.title: Pipeline #{{.Number}} failed on {{.Branch}}
notify.pipeline.succeeded.title: Pipeline #{{.Number}} succeeded on {{.Branch}}
notify.deploy.succeeded.title: Deployed {{.Version}} to {{.Environment}}
notify.deploy.failed.title: Deployment of {{.Version}} to {{.Environment}} failed
notify.alert.firing.title: Alert firing: {{.Rule}}
notify.alert.resolved.title: Alert resolved: {{.Rule}}
email.link_fallback: If the button doesn't work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
email.footer: This email was sent by OpsHub. If you didn't expect it, you can ignore it.
email.verify_email.subject: Confirm your email address
email.verify_email.heading: Confirm your email
email.verify_email.body: Please confirm your email address to finish setting up your OpsHub account. This link expires in 24 hours.
email.reset_password.subject: Reset your OpsHub password
email.reset_password.heading: Reset your password
email.reset_password.body: We received a request to reset your password. This link expires in 1 hour and can be used once. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email — your password won't change.
email.password_changed.subject: Your OpsHub password was changed
email.password_changed.heading: Your password was changed
email.password_changed.body: The password for your OpsHub account was just changed and other devices were signed out. If this wasn't you, reset your password immediately and contact your administrator.
email.account_exists.subject: Sign-up attempt on OpsHub
email.account_exists.heading: You already have an account
email.account_exists.body: Someone tried to create an OpsHub account with this email address, but an account already exists. If it was you, sign in or reset your password. Otherwise, no action is needed.
email.two_factor_enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was enabled
email.two_factor_enabled.heading: Two-factor authentication enabled
email.two_factor_enabled.body: Two-factor authentication was just turned on for your OpsHub account. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe. If this wasn't you, reset your password immediately.
email.two_factor_disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication was disabled
email.two_factor_disabled.heading: Two-factor authentication disabled
email.two_factor_disabled.body: Two-factor authentication was just turned off for your OpsHub account. If this wasn't you, reset your password immediately and turn it back on.
email.invitation.subject: {{.Inviter}} invited you to {{.Org}} on OpsHub
email.invitation.heading: Join {{.Org}} on OpsHub
email.invitation.body: {{.Inviter}} invited you to join {{.Org}} as {{.Role}}. Sign in or create an account with this email address to accept. The invitation expires in 7 days.
notify.alert.subject: {{.Subject}}
notify.alert.summary.certificate_expirin: {{.Subject}}: the TLS certificate expires in {{.Days}} days ({{.Date}}).
notify.test.title: Test message from OpsHub
notify.test.body: This is a test of the notification channel {{.Channel}}. Alerts from {{.Org}} will arrive here.
email.alert.subject: [{{.Severity}}] {{.Title}}
email.alert.heading: {{.Title}}
email.alert_test.subject: Test message from OpsHub
email.alert_test.heading: Notification channel test
email.alert_test.body: This is a test of the notification channel {{.Channel}}. Alerts from {{.Org}} will arrive at this address.
